Package com.eloview.sdk.networkManager

package com.eloview.sdk.networkManager
  • Class
    Description
    CertificateConfig
    This is a model class which used to keep the certificate configuration data.
    CertificateType
    CertificateConfig only accepts a certificate type which is defined in the enum @CertificateType
    ESTConfig
    EstConfig class contains the certificate details, which is required for EST Certificate to installation.
    Network
    Network class provides the following functions.
    A method called setNetwork which is used to connect to a user-defined network configuration A method called getNetwork which returns the information about the current network the device is connected to, such as the network name, network type, IpAddress and MacAddress A method called getWiFiMac which returns the WiFi Mac Address A method called getEthernetMac which returns the Ethernet Mac Address A method called installCertificate This method is used to send the EST Certificate configuration request.
    NetworkConfig
    This is a model class which used to keep the network configuration data.
    NetworkSecurityType

    NetworkType
    NetworkConfig only accepts a network type which is defined in the enum @NetworkType
